name: hookify
description: Warn about or block unwanted agent behaviour with simple Markdown rules (.navin/hookify.<name>.local.md), created from an instruction or from the conversation, checked natively on every action.

steps.step: create a rule from an instruction or the conversation
find the behaviours the user corrected
list the rules and their state
write or fix a rule by hand
write a full shell hook instead of a rule
